verdict.rationale: An admin audit log is a fair security axis for a work-management SaaS like Wrike, but the evidence pack never mentions an audit log or a record of workspace actions. The related items (customer-managed encryption keys, raw analytical data export, dashboards) are adjacent features, not an audit log, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace
